hero.title: Physical space, running on NVIDIA.
hero.summary: XpaceOS creates the content, puts it on screen, understands the room through its digital twin and sells every impression — at the edge, in real time.

objective: Agree on one pilot space where XpaceOS runs end to end on NVIDIA edge compute, with published numbers: latency, uptime, impressions and yield.

skeleton.title: The premise
skeleton.message: Every space is already a screen, a signal and a decision.
skeleton.detail: Screens, sensors, content and media buying still live in separate silos, and nobody closes the loop with what happened in the room. The GPU is already in the store — it just isn't running the store.

skeleton.title: Not a concept
skeleton.message: We didn't bring a deck to Shoptalk. We brought the system running.
skeleton.detail: Shoptalk Europe 2026, Fira Barcelona: the booth was the demo, governed live from its own digital twin — screens, audio, lighting and scent, under 200 ms.

skeleton.title: The system
skeleton.message: An operating system for physical space.
skeleton.detail: Four connected layers: PixerIA creates, admira.tv broadcasts, XpaceOS understands and OmniPublicity monetises.

skeleton.title: Where NVIDIA fits
skeleton.message: Three jobs, three kinds of compute.
skeleton.detail: Inference at the edge (the room decides locally, no feed leaves the building), twin reconstruction on a compact GPU node, and models that stay in the store.

skeleton.title: The on-ramp
skeleton.message: Every space addressable without a survey crew.
skeleton.detail: XpaceScan turns 60–120 s of phone video into the twin XpaceOS governs. Live today; GPU reconstruction is the piece to build together.

skeleton.title: Why it pays for itself
skeleton.message: Every physical slot, auctioned by impression.
skeleton.detail: Once modeled, each screen, zone and moment is addressable supply with proof-of-play, sold programmatically instead of by rate card.

skeleton.title: Where it lands
skeleton.message: From flagship to booth: media that runs itself.
skeleton.detail: Retail and flagships, experience centers, trade-show booths, campus and venues.

skeleton.title: What we're asking for
skeleton.message: One pilot, one reference architecture, one stage.
skeleton.detail: A joint pilot space, technical validation and sizing, and co-presence at NRF and Shoptalk with the twin running live.

skeleton.title: Next 90 days
skeleton.message: What we commit to before the next show.
skeleton.detail: 30: reconstruction on the GPU node. 60: pilot space instrumented with a public dashboard. 90: first programmatic revenue out of the pilot.

closing.title: Pick one space. We'll run it on NVIDIA.
closing.action: Define hardware, space, two visitor journeys, owners and metrics for the pilot.

notes: English only — the audience is NVIDIA. Lead with what already runs (Shoptalk, <200 ms, 20 apps on admira.tv) before asking for anything. Roadmap items are labelled as roadmap on purpose: nothing in the deck claims a capability we have not shipped.
